 Six Western Big 6 teams are in the football playoffs. Here’s the conference’s postseason history
 By: Evan Massey 
 October 22, 2026 
 Local News , Local Sports 
 Evan Massey is a former Galesburg High School girls basketball coach who retired as one of the most successful coaches in Illinois history. He writes history features and a weekly Time Capsule column for WGIL. 
 History of IHSA Football Playoffs 
 1974 – 5 Classes of 16 Teams – 80 Total Teams
1980 – 6 Classes of 16 Teams – 96 Total Teams
1985 – 6 Classes of 32 Teams – 192 Total Teams
2000 – 8 Classes of 32 Teams – 256 Total Teams
2026 – 8 Classes of 48 Teams – 384 Total Teams **
 ** In each class 16 teams receive a Bye and 32 teams play in what is called the “Opening Round.” Teams who win in the “Opening Round” advance to play the Bye teams in the “First Round.”
